claude_proposed_widenings.name: alter_appearance
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Disguise Self modifies the caster's own appearance illusively — clothing, armor, weapons, and body shape — for a timed duration. No existing atom models personal appearance modification. The closest candidate, `create_illusion`, covers free-standing insubstantial projections (Silent Image, Minor Illusion) with a `maxSize: Size` field that doesn't map to wrapping the caster's own form. Using `create_illusion` would misrepresent the rule: the illusion is not a separate object in space but an overlay on the caster's appearance.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have.

discrepancies: no content/disguise_self.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
